abstract: Chemotherapy, in conjunction with other methods of treatment, was used in 100 patients with invasive hydatidiform mole or choriocarcinoma following mole. When treatment was instituted within two to six months of the antecedent mole serious drug resistance was not encountered, drug toxicity was slight, the duration of treatment was comparatively short, and sustained remissions were obtained in 57 out of 60 patients. When the start of chemotherapy was delayed beyond six months drug resistance occurred in many instances, toxicity was often severe, the duration of treatment was much longer, and sustained remissions were obtained in 22 out of 40 patients.The practice of giving prophylactic chemotherapy to all patients with mole is not established as effective or safe. Differences in the social background to hydatidiform mole in different geographical areas may be such that conclusions based on evidence from one area are not necessarily applicable to another.Careful follow-up after mole remains essential, though present methods often fail to ensure recognition of choriocarcinoma while it is still curable. Standard qualitative and quantitative methods for detecting the continued excretion of chorionic gonadotrophin, though useful, are sometimes too insensitive. It is suggested that to supplement local arrangements some form of centralized or regionalized follow-up service based on notification of patients with hydatidiform mole, and making use of radioimmunoassays for chorionic gonadotrophin, could reduce deaths attributable to late diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 侵入奇胎または胞状奇胎後の絨毛癌と診断された100例に対し、化学療法を中心に他の治療法を組み合わせて治療を行った。奇胎発症後2〜6か月以内に治療を開始した場合、重篤な薬剤耐性はみられず、薬剤毒性は軽微で、治療期間は比較的短く、60例中57例で持続寛解が得られた。化学療法の開始が奇胎後6か月を超えて遅れた場合、多くの症例で薬剤耐性が生じ、毒性は高度になることが多く、治療期間は著しく長くなり、40例中22例でのみ持続寛解が得られた。奇胎の患者に予防的化学療法を全例に行うことは、有効性や安全性が確立されていない。奇胎の社会的背景は地域により異なるため、ある地域の証拠に基づく結論が他の地域にそのまま当てはまるとは限らない。奇胎後の慎重なフォローアップは依然として不可欠であるが、現行の方法では治癒可能な段階の絨毛癌を確実に認識できないことが多い。絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの持続的排泄を調べる標準的な定性・定量法は有用ではあるが、感度が不十分なこともある。地域の体制を補うため、胞状奇胎患者の届け出に基づき、絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの放射免疫測定法を用いる中央集約型または地域集約型のフォローアップ体制を導入すれば、診断の遅れによる死亡を減らせる可能性があると提案している。
